name: Sari Wulandari
quote_id: Footage kami berantakan, tapi Arka bisa menemukan ceritanya. Iklannya masih kami pakai sampai sekarang.
quote_en: Our footage was a mess, but Arka found the story in it. We're still running that ad today.

name: Gilang Mahendra
quote_id: Dia mengedit sambil mendengarkan lagunya, bukan cuma melihat gambarnya. Setiap potongan jatuh tepat di ketukan.
quote_en: He edits while listening to the song, not just watching the picture. Every cut lands right on the beat.

name: Dewi & Krisna
quote_id: Kami menangis menonton highlight-nya. Momen kecil yang kami sendiri sudah lupa, semuanya ada di sana.
quote_en: We cried watching the highlight film. Little moments we'd already forgotten were all there.
